basis: Full current academic contract run, including the registered fixture-family envelope correction. No printed question, key, source, blind view, prompt, expected label or observed academic outcome was edited after fit evaluation.
limitations: 64 independently source/key audited positive roots with shared documents and 32 derived correlated controls; counts are not independent statistical observations.
12 intended valid roots failed; three Business Studies fixtures carried numerical route metadata despite non-numerical printed questions. Those failures remain in the denominator.
81.25% valid retention is below the 85% release policy threshold for this set alone. A complete current-contract regression and formal combined assessment are still required.
Zero accepted controlled defects does not establish perfect accuracy.
